def objrot():
 q=d.xquat[obj].copy(); return Rot.from_quat([q[1],q[2],q[3],q[0]]).as_matrix()
def solve(pdes,Rdes,seed=None):
 old=d.qpos.copy()
 q=old[arm_qadr].copy() if seed is None else seed.copy()
 rd=Rot.from_matrix(Rdes)
 for it in range(100):
  d.qpos[:]=old; d.qpos[arm_qadr]=q; mj.mj_forward(m,d)
  p=d.xpos[body].copy(); Rc=d.xmat[body].reshape(3,3).copy()
  ep=pdes-p; er=(rd*Rot.from_matrix(Rc).inv()).as_rotvec()
  if np.linalg.norm(ep)<1e-4 and np.linalg.norm(er)<1e-3: break
  jp=np.zeros((3,m.nv)); jr=np.zeros((3,m.nv)); mj.mj_jacBody(m,d,jp,jr,body)

  dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.diag([.002]*3+[.01]*3),e)
  n=np.linalg.norm(dq)
  if n>.25:dq*=.25/n
  q=np.clip(q+dq,s.lower[:7],s.upper[:7])
